scope: Move and unpin Finder like any other application in the Dock.
approval: Maintainer approved the before, after and Finder context menu previews for paired publication.

checks.command: KDE neon Wayland VM: drag Finder from first to fourth, restart Plasma, then remove Finder through its context menu and verify the saved pins.

coverage_limits: Shared Dock behavior exercised on a Golden Gate configured KDE neon Wayland VM with the candidate component installed. Full installer qualification and a separate Tahoe desktop capture were outside this check.
